veranderings.blok: Land en water op die aardbol
veranderings.voor: bedek saam die grootste deel van die aarde
veranderings.na: bedek saam die grootste deel van die aarde se oppervlak
veranderings.rede: The lesson uses the wording listed as NIE under BESKERM; the protected form says water covers most of the surface, not most of the earth.

veranderings.voor: Draai die aardbol na die Stille Oseaan.
veranderings.na: Draai die aardbol tot jy die Stille Oseaan sien.
veranderings.rede: 'Draai die aardbol na' is an English-shaped instruction; turning until you see the ocean is the natural Afrikaans phrasing.
In standard written Afrikaans for learners an ocean is referred to as 'dit', not 'hy'.

veranderings.voor: kyk goed na wat om hom lê
veranderings.na: kyk goed na wat rondom dit lê
veranderings.rede: 'om hom' for a continent is colloquial and reads awkwardly; 'rondom dit' is clearer in written Afrikaans.

vlae.teks: Gebruik die rigtings om te sê waar die ander kontinente lê.
vlae.rede: 'die rigtings' is vague on its own; if an earlier lesson's term (e.g. compass directions) is meant, the writer should name it rather than a language agent guessing.
